title: Ordinary affine derived mate before extension of source cohomology
statement: Let R,A,B,D be commutative rings, with R-algebra structures on A and B and an E-algebra structure on D, where E=A\otimes_R B and \alpha:E\to D is its structure map. Let j:B\to E be b\mapsto1\otimes b. Let \phi:A\to D and \psi:B\to D be the restrictions of \alpha. Assume the induced spectrum square with f:Spec A\to Spec R, g:Spec B\to Spec R, p:Spec D\to Spec A and f':Spec D\to Spec B commutes; it need not be cartesian. Use the derived categories and quasi-coherent subcategories [def-pc-derived-category] and the canonical derived mate \beta:Lg^*Rf_*K\to Rf'_*Lp^*K [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Let M be an unbounded A-K-flat complex [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], K\in D_{QCoh}(Spec A), e:Q(\widetilde M)\cong K, and assume L=Lp^*K is quasi-coherent and the pullback counit on \widetilde M is invertible. Fix i\in\mathbb Z and the fixed tensor cohomology model m [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Write C=D\otimes_A M, before deriving, with the A-action given by \phi, and V=\Gamma(Spec D,H^i(L)) [lem-pc-affine-derived-cohomology-presentation]. Let b:H^i(C)\cong V be the canonical inverse-counit and e coordinate [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates]. Set c_E:m.cohomology(i)\to res_\alpha H^i(C) to be m.comparison(i) followed by homology of the termwise coefficient map m.ordinaryToLocalized and the exact-restriction homology isomorphism. Let \rho_N:res_\psi N\cong res_j res_\alpha N be the identity-on-carriers restriction-of-scalars comparison, and set c=res_j(c_E) followed by \rho_{H^i(C)}^{-1} followed by res_\psi(b), including the equality transport from \alpha restricted to A to \phi. There exist a natural isomorphism d: (N\mapsto\widetilde{res_\psi\Gamma(H^i(N))})\cong(N\mapsto H^i(Rf'_*N)) on D_{QCoh}(Spec D), and an isomorphism e_C:\widetilde{res_j(m.cohomology(i))}\cong H^i(Lg^*Rf_*K), with e_C followed by H^i(\beta) equal to \widetilde c followed by d_L. The statement concerns the ordinary, unextended source cohomology; it makes no assertion about extension of m.cohomology(i) along \alpha or m.localizedComparison.

proof.text: Take a flat K-flat resolution P of the restriction of M to R using lem-pc-source-module-kflat-resolution. The universal derived scalar extension and counit in m identify its value on M with scalar extension of P to B. Exact tilde, the affine derived-pullback formula and the affine pushforward cohomology calculation identify its cohomology with H^i(Lg^*Rf_*K). Compose with m.cohomologyIso to obtain eC. The source does not depend on D and no cartesian assumption is needed.

For the affine morphism f′:Spec D to Spec B, higher direct images vanish on quasi-coherent modules. Apply the natural unbounded acyclic pushforward cohomology comparison with bound one. The tilde/Gamma counit on each quasi-coherent cohomology sheaf and the natural sections comparison for restriction of scalars give d on the whole quasi-coherent derived category, not just at L.

Use the pinned derived base-change compatibility with the right-derived units on the common K-flat span. The unit-normalized tensor-pullback comparison sends the ordinary mate to the scalar-extension augmentation followed by the coefficient map E to D. Apply cohomology. The equation m.comparison_eq identifies the first factor with m.comparison, and homology of the termwise coefficient map followed by the exact-restriction homology isomorphism gives cE. This uses only the commuting square, not invertibility of the coefficient map or of the base-change mate.

Transport successive restriction of scalars through hφf′ using the natural identity-on-carriers isomorphism ρ. Transport the extended complex through hφg′. The inverse pullback counit and the representative isomorphism e are exactly the factors of b. Their composite with the ordinary cohomology map is c. Reassociation of the preceding mate equation gives eC.hom followed by cohomology of the mate equal to tilde(c) followed by d at L. No source extension or adjoint localized comparison appears.

theorem exists_affineBaseChangeTildeOrdinaryComparison
    (R A R' A' : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R'] [CommRing A']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] R') A']
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R')]
    (φg' : A →+* A') (φf' : R' →+* A')
    (hφg' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) = φg')
    (hφf' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = φf')
    (hw : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg') ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf') ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A)) K)
    (hL : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A'))
      ((derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).obj K))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} A) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅ K)
    (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) (i : ℤ)
 :
    let m := ModuleCat.baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A R' M A'
    let α := algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A'
    let j : R' →+* A ⊗[R] R' := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
    ∃ d : affineDerivedCohomologyModules A' i ⋙
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φf' ⋙ tilde.functor (.of R')) ≅
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A'))).ι ⋙
          schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf')) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of R')).toRingedSpace)) i,
    let L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A')) := ⟨_, hL⟩
    let V := (affineDerivedCohomologyModules A' i).obj L
    let T := tilde.functor (.of R')
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of R')).toRingedSpace)) i
    let C := (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (α.comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let cE := m.comparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap m.ordinaryToLocalized i ≫
      ((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars α)).hom
    let ρ := ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp' j α φf' hφf'.symm
    let b := affineBaseChangeTildeCohomologyIso A A' φg' K M e hc i
    let z := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A') (.up ℤ) i).map
      (eqToHom (by dsimp only [C, α]; rw [hφg'] : C =
        ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φg').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)) ≫ b.hom
    let c := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).map cE ≫
      ρ.inv.app (C.homology i) ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φf').map z
    ∃ eC : T.obj ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).obj (m.cohomology i)) ≅
        H.obj ((derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).obj
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))).obj K)),
      eC.hom ≫ H.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) hw K) = T.map c ≫ d.hom.app L
